newsitem.title: USA: Ascend stock rises on upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Ascend stock rises on upgrade.

text.p: The stock of Ascend Communications Inc. rose in active trading Wednesday after Merrill Lynch & Co. upgraded the computer networking company's stock.
Ascend rose $4.125 to $47.875 on Nasdaq, where it was the most active issue at midafternoon on volume of 16.6 million shares.
Merrill Lynch, which had previously rated the stock neutral, upgraded it to accumulate for intermediate gains, a market source said.
The Alameda, Calif.-based company on Monday completed its acquisition of Cascade Communications Corp.
Ascend develops, manufactures and sells computer network equipment for telecommunications carriers, Internet service providers and corporate customers worldwide.
